_start.desc: Stock LK entry point; configures MMU (TTBR0/TTBR1) and enables SCTLR_EL1.M

kmain.desc: Primary C kernel init; early arch, platform, heap, spawns bootstrap2 thread

thread_init_early.desc: Initializes scheduler runqueues and idle thread context

arch_early_init.desc: Configures ARMv8 generic timer cntpct_el0 and system counter frequency

platform_early_init.desc: Configures early UART0 (0x11002000 @ 921600 baud) and core APB clocks

heap_init.desc: Initializes LK dlmalloc heap pool in physical DRAM

bootstrap2.desc: Secondary initialization thread; platform_init, display, storage, apps

target_init.desc: UFS controller init, GPT partition table load, key detection online

video_printf.desc: Formats and prints text to video console buffer using bitmap font

video_clean_screen.desc: Clears active framebuffer memory with black pixels

video_set_cursor.desc: Sets text console cursor position in character row and column

mt_disp_update.desc: Pushes dirty bounding box from DRAM framebuffer to MIPI DSI panel scanout
mt_disp_update.signature: void mt_disp_update(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)

detect_key.desc: Reads state of physical hardware keys (VolDown=1, VolUp=6, Power=2/8)

fastboot_register.desc: Registers USB fastboot command handler with permission flags
fastboot_register.signature: void fastboot_register(const char *prefix, void (*handle)(const char *arg, void *data, unsigned int sz), unsigned int flags)

fastboot_publish.desc: Publishes fastboot getvar variable key/value pair

fastboot_fail.desc: Sends 'FAIL' fastboot response packet with error description

fastboot_info.desc: Sends 'INFO' fastboot status line to host console

fastboot_stop.desc: Quiesces and terminates USB fastboot gadget stack

thread_create.desc: Creates a new execution thread in LK scheduler
thread_create.signature: void *thread_create(const char *name, void *entry, void *arg, int priority, usize stack_size)

wdt_pet.desc: Pets / restarts MT6789 hardware watchdog (writes 0x1971 to 0x10007008)

wdt_set_timeout.desc: Programs hardware watchdog timer duration in seconds

platform_halt.desc: Executes hardware shutdown or resets with specific reboot reason code

bio_open_by_label.desc: Opens a block device / partition by GPT partition name (e.g. 'boot')

bio_close.desc: Closes an open block device descriptor

bio_read.desc: Reads raw byte stream from block device at given offset
bio_read.signature: ssize bio_read(struct bdev *dev, void *buf, u64 offset, usize len)

bio_write.desc: Writes raw byte stream to block device at given offset
bio_write.signature: ssize bio_write(struct bdev *dev, const void *buf, u64 offset, usize len)

get_suffix.desc: Returns pointer to current active A/B slot suffix string ('_a' or '_b')

set_active.desc: Updates active boot slot in persistent BCB / misc metadata

kernel_decompress.desc: Decompresses LZ4 / Gzip kernel image from boot partition to DRAM (0x40000000)

cmdline_append.desc: Appends argument string to Linux kernel boot parameters buffer

fdt_setprop.desc: Sets or creates a property in Flattened Device Tree
fdt_setprop.signature: int fdt_setprop(void *fdt, int nodeoffset, const char *name, const void *val, int len)

arch_disable_cache.desc: Flushes and disables D-cache and I-cache before kernel handoff

arch_clean_cache_disable_mmu_and_jump.desc: Clears SCTLR_EL1.M (turns off MMU) and executes branch to physical address
arch_clean_cache_disable_mmu_and_jump.signature: void arch_clean_cache_disable_mmu_and_jump(u64 target, u64 a0, u64 a1, u64 a2, u64 a3)

boot_linux.desc: Stock Linux handoff preparation; masks DAIF, cleans cache, triggers SMC

malloc.desc: Little Kernel dlmalloc heap allocation function

free.desc: Little Kernel dlmalloc heap free function

_start.desc: BL2_EXT entry point in Secure EL3; sets EL3 stack and MMU

bootstrap2.desc: Secondary EL3 thread; hardware power initialization, charging ICs

spsr_drop_routine.desc: Evaluates CurrentEL and configures SPSR_EL3 (0x4FE8) and SPSR_EL2 (0x4FFC) to 0x3c5 (EL1h)

atf_handoff_jump.desc: Cleans caches, turns off EL3 MMU, and branches to ATF BL31 at 0x48200000

kedump_init.desc: Initializes Exception Engine memory buffers and expdb persistence metadata

ZERO_REGION_1.desc: Linker alignment padding before VBAR_EL1 vector table in .text segment

ZERO_REGION_2.desc: Linker alignment padding after VBAR_EL1 vector table in .text segment

ZERO_REGION_3.desc: Linker alignment padding at end of .text segment

unallocated_flash.desc: Trailing unallocated flash partition space in lk.img filled with pure 0x00 bytes; ideal for large standalone payloads

HOOK_APP_FASTBOOT.desc: Fastboot app descriptor entry routine pointer

HOOK_APP_MTBOOT.desc: Android boot (mt_boot) app descriptor entry routine pointer

HOOK_TARGET_INIT_CALL.desc: Call site to target_init() inside bootstrap2(); screen and PMIC are active

HOOK_KERNEL_DECOMP_CALL.desc: Call site to kernel_decompress() inside mt_boot() before Linux execution

HOOK_BL2_EXT_SPSR.desc: Secure EL3 SPSR drop routine in bl2_ext before ATF BL31 handoff

DEADCODE_MSDC_EMMC.condition: ADVAN X1 hardware uses UFS 2.2 storage (ufs-mtk). Strapping bit 10 is 0; platform storage init routes exclusively to ufs_init() at 0x50F31784. The single call site to emmc_init() at 0x50F0253C (tbnz w20, #0xa) is never taken. The entire 27.4 KiB MSDC/eMMC driver subtree is completely unreached at runtime.
DEADCODE_MSDC_EMMC.desc: Unreached eMMC/SDcard driver subsystem; prime candidate for large in-situ stage payloads or custom chainloaders

DEADCODE_MMC_DTS_PATCH.condition: FDT update routine for /soc/mmc@11230000. Never executed on UFS-only device trees.
DEADCODE_MMC_DTS_PATCH.desc: Unused MMC device tree patch routine

DEADCODE_OEM_ULTRAFLASH.condition: Factory production line fastboot ultraflash command handler; never executed in retail bootloader state.

DEADCODE_USB2JTAG.condition: Engineering USB-to-JTAG switch routine; gated on proprietary challenge-response token never present in retail builds.
